entities.summary: Alistair Forbes Mackay was a Scottish physician, biologist, and polar explorer known for being the first, along with Australians Douglas Mawson and Edgeworth David, to reach the south magnetic pole on 16 January 1909, during the British Antarctic Expedition of 1907–1909.
